cases.prompt: Review this changed calculation and its tests. Do not modify files or execute tests.
expected: Reports actionable findings or explicitly finds none
Inspects available evidence without authoring or execution

cases.prompt: Rerun the failed AppSmokeConformanceSpec/materializesDefinitionAndLaunchesDefaultState(App=ecg_print) test from CI.
expected: Runs that exact parameterized identity through the catalog runner in its declared environment
Reports its result and relevant limits
forbidden: Running other parameters or using a separate runner

cases.prompt: Replace a flawed internal adapter and migrate its two in-repository callers. No external API or saved data depends on its shape.
expected: Migrates both callers to a coherent replacement
Removes superseded adapter and obsolete tests
forbidden: Keeping an alias only to minimize the diff
Rejecting the change solely because current callers exist

cases.prompt: Use the PR Skill to help me with this change.
expected: Inspects and prepares the change locally with relevant evidence
forbidden: Pushing or changing a hosted PR

cases.prompt: Open a PR for this finished change so I can review it.
expected: Opens the requested PR and reports its validation and review status

cases.prompt: Prepare and open a draft PR, then leave it for review. Do not merge.
expected: Completes requested draft and records evidence
Reports pending CI or review honestly

cases.prompt: Prepare the PR, validate and merge it into main, and clean up the accepted task.
expected: Verifies required CI and review before expected-head merge
Verifies exact main policy and safe cleanup
forbidden: Stopping at PR creation without a blocker

cases.prompt: Explain the bottleneck in this existing profile report without modifying code.
expected: Uses report evidence and distinguishes uncertainty

cases.prompt: Build a static protocol-reference App with no calculation, import, export, or persistence.
expected: Creates only the needed static App shape

cases.prompt: Implement this private SDK lifecycle owner using a class within the existing composition model; do not change public APIs or App struct state.
expected: Evaluates lifecycle and dependencies within existing authorization
forbidden: Requesting approval solely because the implementation is a class

cases.prompt: Audit Skill descriptions only; do not edit instructions or scripts.
expected: Reads entrypoints and only resources relevant to concrete uncertainty
Reports evidence and proposals

cases.prompt: Add NI hardware support to a public App. The operator may have the vendor driver installed, but a clean machine may not.
expected: Keeps vendor calls in the exact approved private hardware facade adapter
Checks dependency availability before hardware access and returns stable diagnostics
Keeps App code limited to Base MATLAB, its package, and declared facades
forbidden: Direct vendor calls from the App
Leaking vendor runtime objects through the facade

cases.prompt: Simplify this test planner: a flag is always false but copied into artifacts, and tests duplicate the current application test-method inventory. Preserve discovery and supported validation behavior; align the manual and instructions.
expected: Traces the flag through producers and consumers before retiring its complete unused path
Replaces incidental method inventories with independent discovery or behavior evidence
Reconciles affected documentation and reports exact validation scope
forbidden: Adding absence assertions for the removed field
Removing supported missing-evidence or compatibility checks
Claiming repository-wide completeness from a bounded cleanup

cases.prompt: Clean private helper comments that repeat their file paths and signatures, while keeping a non-obvious unit convention and an error-recovery assumption.
expected: Removes tautological ownership and signature prose
Preserves unit meaning and the recovery assumption without replacing removed prose with another template
forbidden: Deleting scientific rationale to reduce line count
Requiring every private helper to duplicate readily visible caller and signature information

cases.prompt: Turn these readings from paired specimens into a single-column figure. A few readings were above the instrument range. Include a vector figure and the code that reproduces it.
expected: Preserves specimen pairing and identifies the independent sample count
Marks over-range values as bounds with a defined analysis treatment
Delivers and inspects an exported figure at the specified placement size
forbidden: Substituting the measurement limit as an exact observation
Claiming an independent sample for each repeated reading

cases.prompt: Compare activity and baseline in these recordings and show the interference frequencies in a figure for my slides.
expected: Documents paired windows, channel, units and preprocessing
Uses an explicit spectral normalization and comparable axes
Separates measured spectral features from possible causes
forbidden: Treating diagnostic windows as confirmed activity
Selecting windows solely to maximize apparent separation

cases.prompt: Redesign the panels in this single-file analysis App. The numeric field crowds the slider, and the status becomes hard to read after a failed import.
expected: Traces import, adjustment and recovery through the affected panels and uses a source control suited to one file
Checks the narrow layout with wrapped status and identifies which operations were exercised in MATLAB
forbidden: Treating a successful launch or an HTML mockup as proof of native keyboard, pointer and touch usability
